task_completion.description: Open the DICOM Send or DICOM Nodes configuration window in Weasis.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A settings or preferences dialog box is visible, specifically showing DICOM node/destination configuration.

task_completion.description: Enter the correct destination parameters: Description (Central PACS), AE Title (PACS_ARCHIVE), Hostname (localhost), and Port (11112).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text fields for Description, AE Title, Hostname, and Port are filled with 'Central PACS', 'PACS_ARCHIVE', 'localhost', and '11112' respectively.

task_completion.description: Save or add the newly configured DICOM destination to the list of nodes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Central PACS' node appears in the list of configured DICOM destinations or the 'Add/Save' button is clicked.

task_completion.description: Select the loaded series and initiate the DICOM Send/Export command.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The user right-clicks the series or uses the 'DICOM Send' menu, and a transfer dialog appears with 'Central PACS' selected as the destination.

task_completion.description: Confirm the DICOM transfer completed successfully.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar reaches 100%, a 'Success' notification appears, or the transfer queue shows the status as 'Sent' or 'Completed'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to configure and send, rather than using command-line tools like 'dcmsend'.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements and interactions within the Weasis application windows rather than a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply move files on the file system to simulate a transfer.
integrity.visual_evidence: The DICOM Send dialog in Weasis is used, showing active network protocol interaction (C-STORE).

integrity.description: The agent typed or pasted the specific parameters into the GUI fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: The specific values 'PACS_ARCHIVE' and '11112' are visible within the Weasis configuration text boxes.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The destination node must be configured with AE Title: 'PACS_ARCHIVE', Host: 'localhost', and Port: '11112'. Although the task description mentions a 'CT series', the actual data loaded in Weasis is an X-Ray Angiography (XA) file from Rubo Medical. The transfer is successful if the Weasis DICOM Send interface indicates completion to the 'Central PACS' destination.
